versions.changelog:
Initial release of WaybackClaw.

- Provides a trust and memory layer for AI agents, enabling verifiable track records of decisions and errors.
- Free, permanent logging of agent decisions and hallucinations with agent authentication.
- Risk/reputation checks on agents and tokens available before financial actions, powered by x402 payments on Base.
- Tiered read pricing in $WBC; some endpoints remain free, others require payment.
- Full setup, API usage, and recommended agent flow documented in SKILL.md.
